idea.title: Weekly Google Trends Surge In Warehouse Worker Strike Searches Signals Labor Disruption
idea.thesis: Spikes in strike-related searches indicate rising labor unrest affecting logistics and supply chains. Labor strikes disrupt industrial and logistics operations, pressuring industrial sector stocks.
data_sources: Google Trends weekly search interest for 'warehouse worker strike'
idea.signal_logic: If weekly search interest rises by 30% compared to prior 4 weeks average
idea.entry_exit: Entry: If weekly search interest rises by 30% compared to prior 4 weeks average Exit: After 3 weeks or when interest declines by 15%
idea.position_sizing: Allocate 5% per signal, max 20% total exposure.
idea.risks: Data source instability, false positives, and regime shifts.
idea.implementation_notes: Use Google Trends weekly search interest for 'warehouse worker strike' via api (weekly).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Labor conflicts in warehouses are common and often announced or discussed weeks in advance.

idea.implementation_notes: Use USGS daily earthquake activity near major US ports via api (daily).
idea.reason_it_will_fire_in_30_days: Seismic activity frequently fluctuates with occasional clusters near coastal port regions.
